headers.history_sublist:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V)) (tape : Tape V J)
    (h : ℕ) (l : List (Sym2 V)) :
    ((history Q w t eligible host tape h l).map Prod.fst).Sublist l
headers.history_edges:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V)) (tape : Tape V J)
    (h : ℕ) (l : List (Sym2 V)) :
    edges Q w t eligible host tape h l=
      Q∪((history Q w t eligible host tape h l).map Prod.fst).toFinset
headers.history_approved:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 V)) (w : Sym2 V → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (f h : ℕ) (eligible : Sym2 V → Finset J) (host : J → Finset (Sym2 V))
    (tape : Tape V J) (l : List (Sym2 V))
    (hacc : AccurateTrace Q w t f eligible host tape h l) :
    ApprovedHistory Q w t f h eligible host (history Q w t eligible host tape h l)
